metadata.title: Kubernetes AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Kubernetes Governance Benchmark

components.title: Kubernetes
components.description: AI/ML component for Kubernetes with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed AI workload is linked to the exact image, manifest, and runtime configuration

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Record the container image digest, Kubernetes manifests, Helm or Kustomize revision, namespace, service account, resource requests and limits, and runtime configuration for every governed AI workload.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed workloads with linked image digest, manifest revision, namespace, and runtime configuration / total governed workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure workload-lineage completeness reaches 100% before a Kubernetes workload is approved for production.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes is the orchestration layer, so the primary governed unit is the deployed workload plus its runtime configuration.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure deployment topology and traffic exposure are documented for every governed service

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document namespaces, Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress or Gateway exposure, autoscaling settings, storage assumptions, and network dependencies for each governed Kubernetes deployment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed deployments with complete topology, networking, scaling, and storage documentation / total governed deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes behavior depends heavily on service exposure, scaling, and storage topology, so documenting those assumptions is essential.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed workloads use controlled rollout strategies with health validation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use rolling updates, canary patterns, or equivalent controlled rollout strategies together with readiness and liveness validation so bad releases do not fully replace healthy workloads.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Rollout success rate, rollback success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Rollout success rate = governed rollouts meeting health and availability checks / total governed rollouts; rollback success rate = successful recoveries after failed rollout / total rollback tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure rollout and rollback success remain above threshold for governed Kubernetes releases.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes directly controls rollout and rollback behavior for containerized AI services, making this a platform-native reliability control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Latency regression due to orchestration overhead

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure p95 service latency meets the approved objective under representative cluster conditions

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed AI services running on Kubernetes so scheduling, networking, service routing, and sidecars do not push latency beyond the approved service objective.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure endpoint response times under the approved benchmark workload in-cluster and compute p95 and mean latency per governed service.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure p95 service latency remains within the approved service objective for all governed Kubernetes deployments.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes is not the model server itself, but it materially affects runtime latency through scheduling and networking behavior.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services meet throughput targets under representative load

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark governed AI workloads under representative concurrency and request patterns so cluster-level bottlenecks do not undermine throughput expectations.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Requests per second, tokens per second, concurrent-request success rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative load tests and compute sustained throughput and successful-request ratio under the approved cluster and hardware profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure throughput meets or exceeds the approved target for each governed service profile.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes affects throughput through pod placement, resource contention, and service routing, so throughput must be validated at deployment time.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure autoscaling behavior is validated under representative traffic spikes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate HPA, VPA, KEDA, or other approved autoscaling patterns so governed AI workloads scale predictably under demand changes without violating latency or error-rate objectives.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Scale-up latency, p95 latency under autoscaling, autoscaling error rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Run representative traffic spikes and compute scaling response time, latency, and request failures during autoscaling events.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure autoscaling behavior remains within the approved latency and error-rate thresholds under representative traffic conditions.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes provides the scaling substrate for AI services, so autoscaling validation is a direct platform control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed workloads have validated CPU, memory, and accelerator requests and limits

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Set and validate resource requests and limits for governed workloads so unschedulable pods, eviction, OOM kills, and noisy-neighbor failures are reduced.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: OOM kill rate, eviction rate, unschedulable-pod rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: OOM kill rate = pods terminated due to memory exhaustion / total pods; eviction rate = evicted pods / total pods; unschedulable-pod rate = unschedulable pods / total pod scheduling attempts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure OOM kills, evictions, and unschedulable-pod rates remain below threshold for governed workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes directly enforces requests and limits, so this is one of the most important infrastructure controls for AI workloads.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI workloads run with least-privilege security contexts and service accounts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use restricted security contexts, least-privilege RBAC, and approved service accounts so AI workloads do not run with unnecessary permissions.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed workloads meeting approved security-context and RBAC policy / total governed workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure least-privilege compliance reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes provides the native RBAC and workload-security controls that define runtime privileges.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI workloads consume secrets only through approved secret-management paths

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict workloads to approved Kubernetes Secrets, external secret integrations, or vault-backed paths so credentials and tokens are not exposed through unsafe configuration patterns.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed workloads using only approved secret-management paths / total governed workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-secret-path coverage reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes commonly carries model endpoints, API keys, and storage credentials, so secret path governance is critical.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved Services, Ingresses, and public routes are exposed in production

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review Service types, Ingress or Gateway routes, and external exposure so only intended AI endpoints are reachable from approved networks.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = production deployments exposing only approved routes and service endpoints / total governed production deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-endpoint coverage reaches 100% before deployment approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes networking primitives determine which AI APIs are reachable, so endpoint exposure is a direct platform-governance issue.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed namespaces and workloads are protected by approved network policies

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use NetworkPolicies or equivalent controls so only intended east-west and north-south traffic is allowed for governed AI workloads.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed namespaces or workloads with approved network policies enforced / total governed namespaces or workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure network-policy coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes provides native network segmentation mechanisms that are essential for multi-tenant AI platforms.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI workloads expose required metrics, logs, and traces

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Enable and validate metrics, logging, and distributed tracing for governed AI services so performance, failures, and incidents are observable in production.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed workloads with required metrics, logs, and traces enabled and validated / total governed workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure observability coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes itself does not supply all telemetry, but it is the integration point where workload observability must be enforced and validated.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure endpoint error-rate and availability metrics are monitored for every governed deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor request failures, pod restarts, and service health so availability or inference failures are visible during production operation.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Endpoint error rate, pod restart rate, availability

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Endpoint error rate = failed requests / total requests; pod restart rate = restarted containers / total running containers over the observation window; availability = successful service window / total window in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure endpoint error rate and restart rate remain below threshold and service availability remains above threshold.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes exposes restarts and readiness status that are critical for detecting application degradation in AI services.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: PII leakage in served outputs or logs

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services are evaluated for PII leakage and sensitive logging risk

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For user-facing or sensitive AI workloads on Kubernetes, evaluate endpoint responses and operational logs for PII leakage or unauthorized sensitive content retention.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: PII leakage rate, sensitive-log exposure rate, precision, recall

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Leakage rate = successful PII disclosures or sensitive log exposures / total privacy test cases; compute precision and recall where privacy classifiers are used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PII leakage and sensitive-log exposure remain below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes does not generate model outputs, but it does host the services and log pipelines where leakage can become operationally persistent.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure toxicity benchmark results are measured for governed AI endpoints running on Kubernetes

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate governed AI services for toxic-generation behavior before deployment, especially for conversational or general-purpose generative endpoints deployed on Kubernetes.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Score benchmark outputs with a toxicity classifier and compute average toxicity plus the share of outputs exceeding the approved threshold.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure average toxicity and toxic-output rate remain below approved thresholds for release candidates.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes is the deployment platform rather than the model layer, so this rule is about gating services before they are exposed through the cluster.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure hallucination and faithfulness are benchmarked for governed endpoints before Kubernetes rollout

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: For generative or retrieval-augmented services deployed on Kubernetes, run hallucination and faithfulness evaluations before rollout and after material runtime changes.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Faithfulness = supported claims / total claims; hallucination rate = unsupported answers / total evaluated answers on the governed benchmark set.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure faithfulness remains above threshold and hallucination rate remains below threshold before Kubernetes release.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: This rule is relevant because Kubernetes rollouts expose model-serving changes to production, even though Kubernetes itself does not create the model behavior.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure fairness benchmarks are evaluated for governed AI services before production rollout

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Run fairness benchmarks against governed endpoints so deployment-bound service changes do not expose a biased model to production without review.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Demographic parity difference, subgroup error rate, CrowS-Pairs or BBQ score

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compute fairness metrics on the governed benchmark set by exercising the deployed endpoint and compare results to the approved baseline.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup disparity remains below threshold and fairness benchmark scores do not materially regress before deployment.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes is the production rollout surface, so fairness checks should be tied to actual released services rather than only offline artifacts.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: State loss for AI services requiring persistent storage

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed stateful AI workloads use validated persistent storage and recovery procedures

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where AI workloads depend on persisted artifacts, caches, or indexes, validate persistent volumes, claims, and recovery workflows before production use.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Storage recovery success rate, volume-attach failure rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Recovery success rate = successful restoration or remount tests / total storage recovery tests; volume-attach failure rate = failed attach or mount events / total relevant scheduling events.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure storage recovery success remains above threshold and volume-attach failures remain below threshold for governed stateful workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes separates stateless and stateful patterns, so storage validation is essential for vector indexes, caches, or fine-tuned artifacts persisted in-cluster.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Cluster disruption impacts AI service availability

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed workloads have disruption budgets and multi-replica resilience where required

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use PodDisruptionBudgets, multiple replicas, and anti-affinity or topology controls where required so maintenance and node failures do not fully interrupt governed AI services.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Disruption-budget compliance rate, single-point-of-failure exposure rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed workloads meeting required disruption and replica policy / total governed workloads; SPOF exposure rate = workloads lacking required redundancy / total governed workloads.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure disruption-budget compliance reaches 100% and single-point-of-failure exposure remains at zero where redundancy is required.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes natively supports availability controls like replicas and disruption budgets, which are crucial for production AI services.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed workloads satisfy admission and policy controls before deployment

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use approved admission controls or policy engines so governed workloads cannot be deployed unless they satisfy required security, resource, and governance policies.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed workloads evaluated and admitted only through approved policy controls / total governed workloads; bypass rate = deployments succeeding despite failed required policy / total failed policy checks.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure policy-compliance coverage reaches 100% and failed-policy bypass remains at zero for governed workloads.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes is the enforcement point for many enterprise controls through admission and policy layers, so this is a central benchmark rule.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure candidate promotion is backed by benchmark and readiness evidence

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Require release decisions to include evidence for quality, latency, autoscaling, observability, security posture, and deployment lineage before promoting an AI workload on Kubernetes.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = promoted candidates with complete tracked benchmark, observability, security, and lineage evidence / total promoted candidates.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure release-evidence completeness reaches 100% before candidate promotion.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Because Kubernetes is the production release layer for many AI systems, release promotion should require both model-behavior and infrastructure-readiness evidence.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Kubernetes AI deployments cover quality, safety, privacy, rollout, autoscaling, observability, and resilience tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Kubernetes release standard that requires representative testing across endpoint quality, rollout safety, latency, autoscaling, resource isolation, privacy, safety, fairness, observability, and recovery domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Kubernetes AI risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required Kubernetes validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes is the common production substrate for AI platforms, so release readiness needs broad evidence across both model and infrastructure controls.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure served models have complete model-card-style documentation before cluster exposure

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Attach intended use, limitations, benchmark results, fairness results, privacy assumptions, and deployment constraints to each governed model exposed through Kubernetes.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required transparency fields / total required transparency fields for each governed served model.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure model transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Even though Kubernetes is an orchestration platform, model-card-style transparency remains necessary for governed AI deployments running on it.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure cluster, namespace, networking, and runtime assumptions are documented for governed AI systems

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document cluster topology, namespaces, node pools, autoscaling assumptions, runtime classes, service exposure, storage dependencies, and observability scope for each governed Kubernetes AI system.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and deployment fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Kubernetes-based AI systems are shaped as much by cluster and namespace design as by application code, so architecture transparency is essential.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for Kubernetes
